standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, many greetings, and welcome to the Museum!

steps.npc: My name is Jacques and I am the Museum's finest art critic!

steps.player: Looks to me like you're the only one.

steps.npc: This is true. However, in the future, I will have my own entire floor of the Museum with paintings galore!

steps.player: Er... has that been approved, or are you just dreaming?

steps.npc: Ah, I see you're being witty, eh?
Yes! You're poking fun at me! I shall have my gallery. You will see eventually. Then I shall be the one with the last laugh!
I critique the art! See the beautiful colours and the masterful use of the brush to capture perfectly the royal presence...
Just a painting? How could you say such a thing? When you learn how to appreciate the wonderful works of art, you may talk to me.

steps.player: And look at the use of shade and contrast - isn't it just magnificent?

steps.npc: So it is. So perfect, it almost makes me weep with joy! The grandiloquent strokes of the brush convey a kind of mystic quality... It is almost as if he were here with us.
No words can truly describe my feelings, so let us continue to admire this work in silence.

options.text: That was nice, what did it mean?

steps.player: That was nice, what did it mean?

steps.npc: Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell [madame/monsieur].
Swan-white of heart, a sphinx no mortal knows, My throne is in the heaven's azure deep, I hate all movements that disturb my pose, I smile not ever, neither do I weep.

steps.player: That's powerful stuff...and yes, I see what you mean about the painting inspiring you to remember that poem...

steps.npc: I am glad you enjoyed. Please, take ze time to appreciate ze Museum and ze wealth of information 'ere. Come visit me when I 'ave my own gallery!
Eet iz such a shame, but you must 'ave your own opinion, no? Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
